headline: Lightskin Legends ✊🏽: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Lightskin Legends ✊🏽 is projected #16 of 16 with a 486.80 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Jonathan Taylor, Chase Brown, and Javonte Williams. The immediate priority is improving the WR slot without weakening that core. On the Power Rankings webpage's D-AVI ladder, the franchise ranks #5 of 16 with a 255.0 team D-AVI score.
